interpretation: Graph degree is metadata connectivity, not biological influence or evidence strength.
Code cards are selected relationships, not complete dependency closure.
Shared citations do not establish shared specimens, joint fits or empirical covariance.
Shared-fit membership does not supply a covariance coefficient or sampling distribution.
Absent edges mean not represented here, not statistical or mechanistic independence.
Directions name metadata roles; they do not constitute a causal graph.
Duplicate registry UIDs remain separate even when their DOI is identical.
EXAMPLE review comparisons with published fits do not make current values fitted estimates.
Research source cards include direct assays, source fits, published models, reviews and definition checks; inspect the card's evidence role.
Source-comparison membership is distinct from shared-fit membership of current parameters.
Bibliographic DOI nodes are lookup keys; cards and registry identities remain distinct and are not independent observation counts.

meanings.bound_to: The source declaration aliases the target in this input snapshot.
meanings.selected_input_to_code_card: The input occurs in a reviewed, non-exhaustive code relationship card.
meanings.review_describes_parameter: An advisory review preserves this declaration and examines its support.
meanings.review_cites_reference: The review cites an inspected or explicitly unresolved reference.
meanings.reference_has_registry_identity: The same reviewed bibliography item has this separate registry UID.
meanings.parameter_in_shared_fit: The review identifies estimates from the same empirical fit; covariance is unknown.
meanings.declaration_mentions_reference: A literal citation token appears in source text; support is not established.
meanings.example_review_cites_primary_card: An EXAMPLE review attaches a bounded primary-source review card.
meanings.selected_input_to_example_relation: The input is discussed in an advisory relationship; no joint law is inferred.
meanings.example_reference_lists_registry_record: The review lists a saved registry record; candidate/saved DOI disagreement remains explicit.
meanings.research_review_describes_parameter: A bounded source or quantity review discusses this unchanged input.
meanings.research_review_uses_source_card: A source card supplies review context, not an admitted measurement label.
meanings.selected_input_to_quantity_transform: The input participates in a selected static quantity transform; this is not observed covariance.
meanings.parameter_in_source_comparison: This input is discussed in a conditional source/code comparison, not fitted jointly by that source.
meanings.source_comparison_uses_source_card: A comparison cites this source context, which may concern another construct or assay.
meanings.record_has_bibliographic_doi: The records share a bibliographic DOI token only; specimen, fit and independence are not inferred.

limits: Template declarations only; not any run's effective inputs or overrides.
Rename candidates are payload matches, not confirmed renames.
excerpt_verbatim means the reviewed lines still exist verbatim; surrounding code (callers, branches, units upstream) may have changed and needs re-review.
A code-card anchor is one line; a verbatim line is weak evidence the derivation is unchanged.
